modalities.evidence: This dataset includes EEG recordings from two post-stroke patients
Behavioral and EEG data were collected

output.population: Human; Patients with Aphasia after stroke; ages 38–54
output.summary: EEG and picture-naming behavioral data from two patients with chronic post-stroke anomia during an 8-week individualized tACS intervention, recorded at intervention weeks and follow-ups under tACS and no-tACS conditions.
